verdict.rationale: Extend documents a dedicated Split capability with 'Split classifications', identifier keys and split rules. Split is a first-class processing endpoint and CLI command alongside classify, so one packet upload can be segmented into classified sub-documents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each split segment gets its own downstream extraction output, any in-depth detail beyond section headings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of splitting accuracy.

support.subject: As a data engineer, multi-document packets are classified and split automatically — one upload, per-document results

citations.quote: Parse, extract, and split your hardest documents with unmatched accuracy.
